New Train Service Connects Ayodhya and Janakpur

A new train service, the Ayodhya-Janakpur Express, is scheduled to be flagged off on November 23. The service will connect Ayodhya, a significant Hindu pilgrimage site, with Janakpur, a city in Nepal associated with the epic Ramayana. The train's route, stops, and schedule are being detailed.
